## 1. Executive Summary & Architectural Invariants

ConfigFlow is a multi-page web application comprising 11 HTML operational screens in `public/pages/` and 12 client-side JavaScript controllers in `public/js/`. 

### Key Architectural Characteristics
- **Client-Side Authentication & Session**: State is maintained in `localStorage.getItem("user")`. All protected pages check for this key at the top of their corresponding script and redirect to `login.html` if absent.
- **Global User Display**: Every protected page contains `#sidebarUserName` and `#sidebarUserRole` which are populated from the parsed `user` object in `localStorage`.
- **Sidebar & Layout Injection**: `public/js/sidebar.js` dynamically manipulates the navigation bar, logo (`.logo`), stat icons (`.stat-icon`), mobile drawer toggle button (`.mobile-menu-button`), backdrop overlay (`.sidebar-overlay`), and injects a logout button (`.sidebar-logout`).
- **Dynamic Markup Patterns**: Data tables across all pages follow a standardized `<tbody>` replacement pattern where an initial "Loading..." row is replaced by API data or an explicit empty state (`<td colspan="...">No ... found</td>`).
- **Form Controls & Modals**: Sections such as `#projectFormSection`, `#moduleFormSection`, `#requestFormSection`, `#approvalSection`, and `#backupSection` are toggled either via `hidden` boolean attribute or via inline style `style.display = "block"` / `style.display = "none"`.
- **Emoji Contamination**: There are **112 total Unicode emoji/symbol occurrences** across the HTML and JS files (110 in HTML files, 2 in JS files). None are used as data values; all are decorative navigation glyphs, button prefixes, stat card icons, or link prefixes.

## 3. Page-by-Page DOM Inventory & Binding Catalog

### 3.1 `dashboard.html`
- **File**: `public/pages/dashboard.html`
- **Controller**: `public/js/dashboard.js`, `public/js/sidebar.js`
- **Title**: `ConfigFlow - Dashboard`
- **Layout Elements**:
  - Aside: `.sidebar`
    - Header: `.logo`
    - Nav: `nav > a` (9 navigation links)
    - User Panel: `.sidebar-user`
  - Main: `.main-content`
    - Topbar: `.topbar`
    - Grid: `.stats-grid`
    - Sections: `.dashboard-section` (Request Overview, Notifications, Backup and Restore, Recent Change Requests, Project Summary)
- **ID Catalog**:
  | ID | Tag | Description / Data Type | Controller Binding / Action |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `approvalLink` | `<a>` | Nav link for Approvals | Sidebar nav item target |
  | `sidebarUserName` | `<strong>` | Current user full name text | Set to `user.name \|\| "User"` in `sidebar.js` and `dashboard.js` |
  | `sidebarUserRole` | `<span>` | Current user role text | Set to `user.role \|\| "User"` in `sidebar.js` and `dashboard.js` |
  | `welcomeMessage` | `<p>` | Topbar welcome text | Set to `"Welcome back, ${user.name}! ..."` in `dashboard.js:28` |
  | `totalProjects` | `<strong>` | Metric count | Set to `data.totalProjects \|\| 0` |
  | `totalDevelopers` | `<strong>` | Metric count | Set to `data.totalDevelopers \|\| 0` |
  | `pendingRequests` | `<strong>` | Metric count | Set to `data.pendingRequests \|\| 0` |
  | `approvedRequests` | `<strong>` | Metric count | Set to `data.approvedRequests \|\| 0` |
  | `rejectedRequests` | `<strong>` | Metric count | Set to `data.rejectedRequests \|\| 0` |
  | `latestVersion` | `<strong>` | Metric text | Set to `data.latestVersion \|\| "-"` |
  | `pendingBar` | `<span>` | Progress bar fill | `style.width = (val / max) * 100%` in `dashboard.js:70` |
  | `pendingBarValue` | `<strong>` | Bar value label | Updated to count |
  | `approvedBar` | `<span>` | Progress bar fill | `style.width = (val / max) * 100%` in `dashboard.js:70` |
  | `approvedBarValue` | `<strong>` | Bar value label | Updated to count |
  | `rejectedBar` | `<span>` | Progress bar fill | `style.width = (val / max) * 100%` in `dashboard.js:70` |
  | `rejectedBarValue` | `<strong>` | Bar value label | Updated to count |
  | `dashboardNotification` | `<p>` | Status notification string | Text updated based on pending requests count |
  | `backupSection` | `<section>` | Backup/Restore container | Unhidden (`.hidden = false`) if `user.role === "Admin"` |
  | `downloadBackupButton` | `<button>` | Action button | `click` event attached to `downloadBackup()` in `dashboard.js:281` |
  | `backupFile` | `<input file>` | File input | Evaluated in `restoreBackup()` in `dashboard.js:244` |
  | `restoreBackupButton` | `<button>` | Action button | `click` event attached to `restoreBackup()` in `dashboard.js:285` |
  | `backupMessage` | `<p>` | Feedback text | Status output for backup/restore operations |
  | `recentRequests` | `<tbody>` | Table body container | Injected with up to 5 rows via `loadRecentRequests()` |
  | `projectSummary` | `<tbody>` | Table body container | Injected with up to 5 rows via `loadProjects()` |
- **Event Handlers**:
  - `button.logout-btn` -> `onclick="logout()"`
  - `downloadBackupButton` -> `addEventListener("click", downloadBackup)`
  - `restoreBackupButton` -> `addEventListener("click", restoreBackup)`
- **Key CSS Classes**:
  - Layout: `.sidebar`, `.main-content`, `.topbar`, `.stats-grid`, `.stat-card`, `.stat-icon`, `.dashboard-section`, `.table-container`, `.dashboard-bars`, `.dashboard-bar-row`, `.dashboard-bar-track`, `.dashboard-notifications`, `.backup-controls`
  - Components: `.logout-btn`, `.reject-btn`, `.file-button`, `.status`, `.status.pending`, `.status.approved`, `.status.rejected`

### 3.2 `projects.html`
- **File**: `public/pages/projects.html`
- **Controller**: `public/js/projects.js`, `public/js/sidebar.js`
- **Title**: `ConfigFlow - Projects`
- **ID Catalog**:
  | ID | Tag | Description / Data Type | Controller Binding / Action |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `approvalLink` | `<a>` | Nav link | Sidebar nav target |
  | `sidebarUserName` | `<strong>` | User name | Populated from `user.name` |
  | `sidebarUserRole` | `<span>` | User role | Populated from `user.role` |
  | `addProjectButton` | `<button>` | "+ Add Project" button | Unhidden if `user.role === "Admin"`, `onclick="openProjectForm()"` |
  | `projectFormSection` | `<section>` | Form drawer/modal | Display toggled via `style.display = "block"` / `"none"`, unhidden for Admin |
  | `formTitle` | `<h2>` | Form header title | Text set to `"Add Project"` or `"Edit Project"` |
  | `projectId` | `<input hidden>` | Project record ID | Populated on edit; cleared on close |
  | `projectName` | `<input text>` | Project name input | Read during save; populated on edit |
  | `projectDescription` | `<textarea>` | Project description | Read during save; populated on edit |
  | `currentVersion` | `<input text>` | Version string | Read during save; populated on edit |
  | `projectCount` | `<span>` | Counter text | Set to `"${projects.length} Projects"` |
  | `projectsTable` | `<tbody>` | Table body container | Rendered dynamically via `loadProjects()` |
  | `manager-${project.id}` | `<select>` | Manager dropdown | Dynamically rendered inside table row for Admin users |
  | `developer-${project.id}`| `<select>` | Developer dropdown | Dynamically rendered inside table row for Manager users |
- **Event Handlers**:
  - `addProjectButton` -> `onclick="openProjectForm()"`
  - Save button -> `onclick="saveProject()"`
  - Cancel button -> `onclick="closeProjectForm()"`
  - Dynamic Edit button -> `onclick='editProject(${JSON.stringify(project)})'`
  - Dynamic Delete button -> `onclick="deleteProject(${project.id})"`
  - Dynamic Assign Manager button -> `onclick="assignManager(${project.id})"`
  - Dynamic Add Developer button -> `onclick="assignDeveloper(${project.id})"`
- **Key CSS Classes**:
  - `.form-section`, `.table-container`, `.add-btn`, `.edit-btn`, `.delete-btn`, `.cancel-btn`, `.assignment-control`, `.assigned-project-row`, `.assignment-badge.assigned`, `.assignment-badge.not-assigned`

## 4. Client Scripts In-Depth Analysis & Dynamic Generation

### 4.1 `sidebar.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/sidebar.js`
- **Dependencies**: Loaded on 10 of 11 pages (all except `login.html`).
- **Global Exports**: `window.logout()`, `window.showToast(message, type)`
- **DOM Mutations & Injection**:
  1. **User Role/Name**: Reads `localStorage.getItem("user")`, injects `user.name` into `#sidebarUserName` and `user.role` into `#sidebarUserRole`.
  2. **Logo HTML**: Overwrites `.logo` innerHTML:
     ```html
     <span class='logo-mark'>CF</span><span>ConfigFlow<small class='logo-subtitle'>Control workspace</small></span>
     ```
  3. **Sidebar Nav Links**: Iterates `.sidebar nav a`. Strips leading non-alpha chars (`replace(/^[^A-Za-z]+/, "")`) to remove unicode emojis, and injects SVG paths from an internal dictionary:
     ```html
     <span class='nav-icon' aria-hidden='true'><svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'>${icons[page] || ""}</svg></span><span>${label}</span>
     ```
  4. **Section Dividers**: Inserts `<div class='nav-section-label'>Workspace</div>` before index 0, and `<div class='nav-section-label'>Management</div>` before index 4.
  5. **Stat Icons**: Replaces `.stat-icon` innerHTML on `dashboard.html` with inline SVGs matching index order.
  6. **Mobile Navigation Elements**: Creates and appends:
     - `button.mobile-menu-button` (text: `"☰"`) with click listener to toggle `.mobile-open` on `.sidebar`.
     - `div.sidebar-overlay` with click listener to close menu.
     - `button.sidebar-logout` inside `.sidebar-user` with click listener invoking `window.logout()`.
  7. **Toast Notifications (`window.showToast`)**: Appends `.toast-region` to `body` if absent, creates `.toast.toast-${type}`, removes after 4200ms.

---

### 4.2 `login.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/login.js`
- **Key Functions**:
  - `login()`: POST `/api/login` with `{ email, password }`. On success: sets `localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(data.user))` and redirects to `dashboard.html`. On error: sets `#message.innerHTML = data.message`.
  - `togglePassword(inputId, button)`: Toggles input between `password` and `text`, updates `aria-label` attribute on toggle button.
  - `toggleRegistration()`: Flips `.hidden` property of `#loginFields` and `#registerFields`, updates text of `#registerToggle`, clears `#message`.
  - `updateEmployeeIdPreview()`: Debounces/tracks requests with `employeePreviewRequest` counter; GET `/api/employee-id-preview` to fetch next sequential employee ID, populating `#employeeId.value`.
  - `registerDeveloper()`: POST `/api/register` with `{ name, email, password, confirm_password }`. Sets `#message.className = "error-message"` or `"success-message"`.

---

### 4.3 `dashboard.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/dashboard.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - **RBAC**: If `user.role === "Admin"`, sets `#backupSection.hidden = false`.
  - `loadDashboard()`: GET `/api/dashboard`. Populates 6 stat counts, computes bar widths for `#pendingBar`, `#approvedBar`, `#rejectedBar` (`style.width = (value/max)*100%`), and populates `#dashboardNotification`.
  - `loadRecentRequests()`: GET `/api/change-requests?user_id=${user.id}`. Slices first 5 items, injects into `#recentRequests`:
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="4">No change requests found</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${request.title}</td>
          <td>${request.project_name}</td>
          <td>${request.priority}</td>
          <td>
              <span class="status ${request.status.toLowerCase()}">
                  ${request.status}
              </span>
          </td>
      </tr>
      ```
  - `loadProjects()`: GET `/api/projects?user_id=${user.id}`. Slices first 5 items, injects into `#projectSummary`:
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="2">No projects found</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${project.project_name}</td>
          <td>${project.current_version || "-"}</td>
      </tr>
      ```
  - `downloadBackup()`: GET `/api/backup?user_id=${user.id}`. Generates JSON Blob and programmatically clicks download link for `"configflow-backup.json"`.
  - `restoreBackup()`: Reads `#backupFile.files[0]`, parses JSON, POSTs to `/api/backup/restore` with `{ user_id, backup }`.

---

### 4.4 `projects.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/projects.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - **RBAC**: If `user.role === "Admin"`, unhides `#addProjectButton` and `#projectFormSection`.
  - `loadAssignableUsers()`: If Admin or Manager, GET `/api/users/assignable?user_id=${user.id}`.
  - `loadProjects()`: GET `/api/projects?user_id=${user.id}`. Updates `#projectCount`, populates `#projectsTable`:
    - **Empty State**: Role-tailored message in `<td colspan="6">`.
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr class="${Number(project.is_assigned) === 1 ? 'assigned-project-row' : ''}">
          <td>${project.id}</td>
          <td><strong>${project.project_name}</strong></td>
          <td>${project.description || "-"}</td>
          <td>${project.current_version || "-"}</td>
          <td>
              <span class="assignment-badge ${Number(project.is_assigned) === 1 ? 'assigned' : 'not-assigned'}">
                  ${Number(project.is_assigned) === 1 ? 'Assigned' : 'Not assigned'}
              </span>
          </td>
          <td>${actions}</td>
      </tr>
      ```
    - **Actions Generation**:
      - For Admin:
        ```html
        <button class="edit-btn" onclick='editProject(${JSON.stringify(project)})'>Edit</button>
        <button class="delete-btn" onclick="deleteProject(${project.id})">Delete</button>
        <div class="assignment-control">
            <select id="manager-${project.id}">${assignmentOptions("Manager", project.project_manager_id)}</select>
            <button class="add-btn" onclick="assignManager(${project.id})">Assign Manager</button>
        </div>
        ```
      - For Manager (assigned project):
        ```html
        <div class="assignment-control">
            <select id="developer-${project.id}">${assignmentOptions("Developer")}</select>
            <button class="add-btn" onclick="assignDeveloper(${project.id})">Add Developer</button>
        </div>
        ```
      - Other: `"View only"`
  - `assignManager(projectId)`: POST `/api/projects/${projectId}/manager` with `{ manager_id, assigned_by: user.id }`.
  - `assignDeveloper(projectId)`: POST `/api/projects/${projectId}/developers` with `{ developer_id, assigned_by: user.id }`.
  - `openProjectForm()` / `closeProjectForm()`: Toggles `#projectFormSection.style.display = "block"` / `"none"`.
  - `saveProject()`: POST or PUT `/api/projects[/${id}]` with `{ project_name, description, current_version, created_by }`.
  - `editProject(project)`: Opens form and sets `#projectId`, `#projectName`, `#projectDescription`, `#currentVersion`.
  - `deleteProject(id)`: DELETE `/api/projects/${id}` with confirmation prompt.

---

### 4.5 `modules.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/modules.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - `loadProjects()`: GET `/api/projects?user_id=${user.id}`. Populates `#projectId` `<select>` with `<option value="${project.id}">${project.project_name}</option>`.
  - `loadModules()`: GET `/api/modules?user_id=${user.id}`. Populates `#modulesTable`:
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="4">No modules found</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${module.id}</td>
          <td>${module.project_name || "-"}</td>
          <td><strong>${module.module_name}</strong></td>
          <td>
              ${Number(module.can_edit) === 1
                  ? `<button class="edit-btn" onclick='editModule(${JSON.stringify(module)})'>Edit</button>
                     <button class="delete-btn" onclick="deleteModule(${module.id})">Delete</button>`
                  : "View only"}
          </td>
      </tr>
      ```
  - `openModuleForm()` / `closeModuleForm()`: Toggles `#moduleFormSection.style.display = "block"` / `"none"`.
  - `saveModule()`: POST or PUT `/api/modules[/${id}]` with `{ project_id, module_name, created_by, updated_by }`.
  - `editModule(module)`: Populates form inputs and sets `#formTitle.textContent = "Edit Module"`.
  - `deleteModule(id)`: DELETE `/api/modules/${id}` with `{ deleted_by: user.id }`.

---

### 4.6 `changeRequests.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/changeRequests.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - `loadProjects()`: GET `/api/projects?user_id=${user.id}`. Populates `#projectId` `<select>`.
  - `loadModules()`: Triggered on `#projectId` change event. GET `/api/modules`. Populates `#moduleId` `<select>` filtered by matching `project_id`.
  - `submitRequest()`: Reads form fields, constructs `FormData` including `#attachment.files[0]`, POSTs to `/api/change-requests`.
  - `loadRequests()`: GET `/api/change-requests?user_id=${user.id}`. Populates `#requestsTable`:
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="10">No change requests found</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${request.id}</td>
          <td><strong>${request.title}</strong></td>
          <td>${request.project_name || "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.module_name || "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.priority || "-"}</td>
          <td><span class="status ${status.toLowerCase()}">${status}</span></td>
          <td>${request.admin_comment || "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.approved_at ? new Date(request.approved_at).toLocaleDateString() : "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.created_at ? new Date(request.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.attachment ? `<a href="/uploads/${request.attachment}" target="_blank">📎 View File</a>` : "-"}</td>
      </tr>
      ```
      *(Note: `📎 View File` contains emoji to be replaced with Lucide Paperclip SVG)*.

---

### 4.7 `approval.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/approval.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - **RBAC Gate**: Immediately enforces `user.role === "Admin" || user.role === "Manager"`.
  - `loadRequests()`: GET `/api/change-requests?user_id=${user.id}`. Filters for `request.status.toLowerCase() === "pending"`. Populates `#pendingRequestsTable`:
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="7">No pending change requests</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${request.id}</td>
          <td><strong>${request.title}</strong></td>
          <td>${request.project_name || "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.module_name || "-"}</td>
          <td>${request.priority}</td>
          <td>${request.created_by_name || request.created_by || "-"}</td>
          <td>
              <button class="edit-btn" onclick='reviewRequest(${JSON.stringify(request)})'>Review</button>
          </td>
      </tr>
      ```
  - `reviewRequest(request)`: Opens `#approvalSection` (`style.display = "block"`), fills read-only spans and `#requestId.value = request.id`.
  - `closeApprovalForm()`: Hides `#approvalSection` (`style.display = "none"`).
  - `approveRequest()` / `rejectRequest()`: Invokes `updateRequestStatus("Approved")` or `"Rejected"`.
  - `updateRequestStatus(status)`: Validates `#adminComment`, PUT `/api/change-requests/${id}/approve` with `{ status, admin_comment, approved_by: user.id }`.

### 4.8 `versions.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/versions.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - `loadVersions()`: GET `/api/versions`. Populates `#versionsTable` and calls `populateVersionSelects(versions)`.
    - **Empty State**: `<tr><td colspan="5">No versions found</td></tr>`
    - **Row Markup**:
      ```html
      <tr>
          <td>${version.id}</td>
          <td>${version.project_name || "-"}</td>
          <td><strong>${version.version}</strong></td>
          <td>${version.description || "-"}</td>
          <td>${version.release_date ? new Date(version.release_date).toLocaleDateString() : "-"}</td>
      </tr>
      ```
  - `populateVersionSelects(versions)`: Populates both `#olderVersion` and `#newerVersion` `<select>` elements with `<option value="${version.id}">${version.version} - ${version.project_name}</option>`.
  - `compareVersions()`: Reads `#olderVersion.value` and `#newerVersion.value`. Constructs comparison cards inside `#versionComparison`:
    - Generates 2 `.version-comparison-panel` elements (one for Older version, one for Newer version) containing `<h3>`, `<strong>`, and `<p>`.
  - `loadReleaseNotes()`: GET `/api/release-notes`. Injects cards into `#releaseNotesContainer`:
    - **Card Markup**:
      ```html
      <div class="release-note-card">
          <h3>${note.version || "Version"}</h3>
          <p>${note.notes || "-"}</p>
      </div>
      ```

---

### 4.9 `releaseNotes.js`
- **Location**: `public/js/releaseNotes.js`
- **Key Functions & Dynamic Generation**:
  - **RBAC**: If `currentUser.role === "Admin"`, unhides `#releaseNoteFormSection`.
  - `loadVersionsForReleaseNote()`: GET `/api/versions`. Populates `#releaseVersion` dropdown.
  - `publishReleaseNote()`: Validates inputs, POST `/api/release-notes` with `{ version_id, notes, created_by }`.
  - `loadReleaseNotes()`: GET `/api/release-notes`. Builds programmatic DOM structure with `createReleaseNoteCard(note)`:
    - **Card Tree**:
      - `article.release-note-card`
        - `h3` (`note.version`)
        - `div.release-note-meta`
          - `span` (`"Project: "` + `strong` (`note.project_name`))
          - `span` (`"Released: "` + formatted date)
        - `p.release-note-body` (`note.notes`)

## 6. Implementation Guidelines & Zero-Regression Guardrails

To guarantee 100% functional integrity while refactoring the UI/UX:

1. **Strict ID & Name Preservation**:
   - Every ID listed in Section 3 and Section 5 is mandatory. Do not rename, remove, or modify any ID.
   - Form inputs (`#email`, `#password`, `#projectName`, `#requestTitle`, etc.) must maintain their exact input types, IDs, and value access contracts.

2. **Preserve Dynamic HTML Structure**:
   - Table bodies (`#recentRequests`, `#projectsTable`, `#modulesTable`, `#requestsTable`, `#pendingRequestsTable`, `#versionsTable`, `#projectReportTable`, `#versionReportTable`, `#auditTable`, `#searchResults`) must remain as valid `<tbody>` elements.
   - Column counts in headers (`<th>`) must match the `colspan` values used in empty/loading states in the JavaScript controllers (e.g. 10 columns for `#requestsTable`, 9 columns for `#searchResults`, 7 for `#pendingRequestsTable`, 6 for `#projectsTable`, 5 for `#auditTable` and `#versionsTable`, 4 for `#modulesTable` and `#recentRequests`, 2 for `#projectSummary`).

3. **Status and Badge Classes**:
   - Status spans use lowercase class naming: `.status.pending`, `.status.approved`, `.status.rejected`.
   - Project assignment badges use `.assignment-badge.assigned` and `.assignment-badge.not-assigned`.
   - Projects assigned to the user use row class `.assigned-project-row`.

4. **Action Button Classes**:
   - Dynamic buttons rendered via JS use specific class hooks: `.edit-btn`, `.delete-btn`, `.add-btn`, `.approve-btn`, `.reject-btn`, `.cancel-btn`, `.logout-btn`. CSS refactoring must style these classes cleanly.

5. **Sidebar Dynamic Replacement Behavior**:
   - `sidebar.js` strips leading non-letter characters (`replace(/^[^A-Za-z]+/, "")`) and replaces link innerHTML with `<span class='nav-icon'>...</span><span>${label}</span>`.
   - If SVG icons are hardcoded directly into the HTML templates, ensure `sidebar.js` is adjusted or aligned so that double-rendering or icon clobbering does not occur.
   - The stray link on `versions.html:178` (`<a href="versions.html">🚀 Versions</a>`) must be cleanly removed.

6. **Emoji Replacement Mapping**:
   - Replace all 112 occurrences in accordance with Section 2.
   - For `public/js/changeRequests.js:445`, replace `📎 View File` with `<svg class="icon" ...>...</svg> View File` or semantic text/icon button.
   - For `public/js/sidebar.js:63`, replace `menuButton.textContent = "☰"` with an inline SVG element or clean menu icon class.

7. **Modal & Form Display Mechanics**:
   - Note that `#projectFormSection`, `#moduleFormSection`, `#requestFormSection`, and `#approvalSection` toggle using `.style.display = "block"` / `.style.display = "none"`.
   - `#backupSection`, `#addProjectButton`, and `#releaseNoteFormSection` toggle using the `.hidden` property (`false` / `true`).
   - CSS styling must accommodate both `.hidden` attribute and `display: none` / `display: block` transitions without layout collisions.
